_about: Public-domain Henry Grattan Guinness (1835-1910), Irish evangelist, founder of the East London Training Institute and writer on prophecy, for the Word Hoard: Sermons (1860), The Approaching End of the Age (1880), Light for the Last Days (1886), The Wide World and our Work in it (1886), Romanism and the Reformation (1887), The Divine Programme of the World's History (1888), The New World of Central Africa (1890), The City of the Seven Hills (1891), Creation Centred in Christ (1896) and History Unveiling Prophecy (1905), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 58 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
